limitations: This is an interim audit of a fixed completed subset, not a statement that all60 candidates are finished.
Changed parameter counts measure observed optimizer updates; nominal count does not imply every scalar weight participates in each task.
Recorded post-tick margins and channel values on32 training episodes do not reveal internal-substep crossings, resets, event sparsity or trained biological spiking.
method: Read-only completed receipts, per-update clocks, all checkpoint arrays and saved training diagnostics. No validation/test examples, model scores or hyperparameter selection read. No new training runs or changed scientific thresholds.
